_doc: Reviewed known Vulkan validation hits. A formatted [VK_VALIDATION v1] error, or a raw 'Validation Error: [ ...' line the engine callback did not format, is NOT red only when an entry here matches its id (and text_contains, when given) and the entry has not expired. Everything else is red. An entry is {id, text_contains, reason, reviewed, expires (ISO date)}. An expired entry is red again: fix the hazard or re-review it. Keep this list small. Empty on purpose: the shadow.bake.mask WAW was fixed in vkcore (d6f27b463), so a regression must be red.
